overview: The City Council commemorated the life of long-time community figure Lenny Gliona and approved a $450,000 grant for the Medford Square Redevelopment Project. Key decisions included authorizing the Fire Department's capital vehicle purchases and advancing a new Vacant Building Ordinance for its first reading.

items.title: Resolution Commemorating Leonard Glenn Gliona
items.summary: The Council commemorated the life of Lenny Gliona, a veteran and dedicated mentor in Medford politics. Approved.

items.title: Unfinished Business and Records
items.summary: Approved various committee reports and meeting records, and voted to place several outdated requests regarding zoning and local businesses on file.

items.title: CDBG Action Plan Fiscal Year 2027 Public Hearing
items.summary: The Council held a public hearing on the city's plan for an estimated $1,433,520 in federal block grant funds. Approved the submittal of the plan to HUD.

items.title: Board Appointments and Food Truck Permits
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Roberta Cameron to the Historic District Commission and granted food truck permits for the Medford Youth Girls Softball tournament at Tufts Park.

items.title: Fire Department Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriation
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of approximately $2.1 million for a new ladder truck, equipment for two pumpers, and three administrative vehicles. Fire Chief Todd Evans noted the long procurement lead times and the need to replace vehicles from 2014 and 2015.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Approved reclassifying the Assistant Network Administrator to a 40-hour week and authorized a 2.5% base salary increase for non-union personnel effective July 1, 2026.

items.title: Proposed Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: Councilors proposed establishing a registry and escalating fee structure for vacant commercial properties to combat blight and encourage active tenancies. The draft ordinance was approved for first reading, while the associated repeal of the existing zoning section was referred to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Medford Square Redevelopment Project Grant
items.summary: Approved a $450,000 MassDevelopment grant to fund the archeological excavation and reinternment of human remains at a municipal site partially paved over during the construction of Interstate 93. Approved.
